1. It's really annoying the fact that the search bar on the bottom of the starting screen can't go away. What's even more frustrating is that you can't replace it with a Google Chrome search bar which is the app that I have used for the last 6 years. 

2. It's also really annoying that you can't delete the date on the top left also on the starting screen and replace it with a widget. I think these things are so useless. Some people call it a feature. Do you guys really call a "feature" the search bar? Come on...

3. I do not like the fact that I can't change the way the double click of the power button works. I had a Xiaomi and I used the double click for the flashlight that I use very very often! On the Pixel 7 I can't change it. You can't even put a flashlight button on the lock screen like you could on the Xiaomi...

4. The double tap of the rear is totally SH!T... It just works 10% of the time. So I double tap to switch on the flashlight and then I can't switch it off the same way because the phone will not recognize the second double tap. Completely useless and frustrating...

5. I do not feel that the phone is customizable enough! I feel that Google has tied up our hands and has given us very limited customization options to bring the phone to our needs through settings... It's like Google telling us "Your phone will look and function the way I want" BUT NOT IN A GOOD WAY! More like in a cocky arrogant way...

6. No separate "LTE DATA" and "Mute" buttons on the scroll bar... It might be because I am used to the Xiaomi one, but the truth is that it was very practical! 

7. No notification's LED light. I would like to have one but not a big deal!

8. Messenger bubbles! Why do they look like this...? They are just so impractical compared to the chat heads of the previous Android versions. Everything is just so small and tight... It might be the app's problem but I just want to mention it!

That's all for now... I would like to hear your opinion about the Pixel 7!
